exposure: type of delivery (vaginal or cesarean section)
duration of baby's separation from mother's womb
duration of exposure to anesthetic agent
cohort: The study included 441 newborns whose hearing was evaluated within the scope of the Newborn Hearing Screening Program.
finding: A statistically significant relationship was found between delivery type and anesthesia method and first screening ABR test results.
mod_finding: The type of delivery (vaginal or cesarean section) and the anesthesia method used at delivery may affect the results of screening ABR applied within the scope of a newborn hearing screening protocol.
cross-section timing: Within the scope of the Newborn Hearing Screening Program (newborn period)
